scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > build/package.json && node build/server/main.js
scripts.assets:thumbs: bash -c 'for f in public/assets/cards/card-*.png; do cwebp -quiet -q 85 -alpha_q 100 -resize 476 596 "$f" -o "public/assets/thumbs/$(basename "$f" .png).webp"; done'
